verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM presents itself as an AI assistant/agent ("a privacy-focused, extensible, and capable AI agent running on your device"), which puts it in the MCP client role. Its "MCP Compatibility" docs describe consuming MCP servers, and the automated probe's "official MCP server" label points at that same client-compatibility page. No evidence shows AnythingLLM itself running as an MCP server, such as a serve mode or a hosted MCP endpoint, so this server axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
